topic: Create an SCI vs do LMNP on France
linkedin_angle: French property ownership can be a fantastic investment for expats, but choosing the right legal structure is critical. I recently analyzed the differences between setting up an SCI (Société Civile Immobilière) and opting for the LMNP (Loueur en Meublé Non Professionnel) status. Key differences lie in taxation, administration, and suitability for furnished vs. unfurnished rentals. While SCI offers flexibility in ownership and transmission, LMNP can provide significant tax advantages through depreciation, especially for furnished rentals. However, an SCI renting furnished property can trigger corporate tax. My latest brief dives deep into these nuances to help expats make an informed decision. #ExpatFrance #FrenchProperty #RealEstateInvestment #Taxation #SCI #LMNP
